note: Paths that request publication (website_publish: true) but are demoted by the publication policy at the pinned revisions. This is the docs-side frontmatter flip list: the entry's `source` corpus sets website_publish: false (or removes the field) on its path, and the entry is deleted here in the same coordinated change. Shrink-only. T8 (bitty-website#98) added the 15 bitty-docs governance pages that the advanced pin makes request publication (bitty-docs#374 enables website_publish on referenced governance docs): 9 are pages the revision adds and 6 had their frontmatter flipped. All 15 are demotions, not withhold entries: the #97 rule resolves a forbidden governance path that requests publication as demote (recorded here, ships a 301) or violation (fails the build), never as withhold. None of the 15 had a served route before, so each demotion adds a 301 for a route that previously served nothing; withholding them instead would mean changing the rule's precedence, which is out of this change's scope. The fix belongs to bitty-docs: drop website_publish: true from these pages.
